reply_text:
I’d fix one issue before merging.

**[P2] Only the first space is removed — `src/normalize.js:4`**
`replace(' ', '')` removes one space, leaving subsequent spaces to fail E.164 validation. All three examples advertised in the README currently throw `bad number` instead of queueing:
- `+44 20 7946 0958`
- `0044 20 7946 0958`
- `+1 (415) 555-0100`

Remove spaces globally and add end-to-end `queueText` tests for these examples. The existing normalization test has only one space, so it misses this.

Reviewed `phone-normalize` at `173e408` against `main`. All 5 existing tests pass; the failures above were reproduced separately. No code changes made.
